name: theguardian.com
comment: Sourcepoint 'consent or pay' wall shown in the EU/EEA (message 1482251) and UK (message 1482252), where the only reject option requires a paid subscription. The container id embeds the Sourcepoint message id, so we target the pay-wall variants specifically to avoid clashing with the free-reject Sourcepoint popup used in other regions (handled by Sourcepoint-frame). Brittle: message ids may change if the campaign is reconfigured. Sourcepoint locks scrolling with '.sp-message-open body { overflow: hidden; position: fixed }', so we override those properties inline on body: the class is re-applied by Sourcepoint (including on bfcache restore), and inline styles survive both without needing a newer rule step version.

optOut.addStyle: position: static !important; top: auto !important; left: auto !important; right: auto !important; width: auto !important; overflow: visible !important
